hero.title: Open the models.
hero.subtitle: The models are open. The agents are autonomous. But who holds the keys when they cross a sovereign border? Human identity was built for people clicking buttons, and it breaks the moment autonomous agents negotiate and act across borders. Genesis Mesh is the treaty layer for machines: the authority to verify, limit, revoke, and audit any system, anywhere.

stakes.label: The Stakes
stakes.title: Digital sovereignty is now a question of national survival - and there is no treaty layer for machines.
stakes.subtitle: States sign treaties. Digital systems have no equivalent. When an AI agent of one nation meets the infrastructure of another, the question - who vouches for this entity, under whose rules, and can that trust be withdrawn - is a diplomatic question that today has no protocol answer. Genesis Mesh is that answer.
stakes.notLine: Not a blockchain. Not a VPN. Not a service mesh. Not an agent framework. Not a marketplace. The treaty layer for machines.
